systems.system: national fibre-optic network (Plan National du Numérique 2026-2030, PNN2)
systems.platform: fibre optic, with a planned submarine cable
systems.owner: Government of DR Congo, with World Bank, EU and private financing
systems.tiers: to reach all 145 territoires and 650 communities, said to benefit 30 million people and 1,000 institutions; no local government office said to be on it

systems.system: Tier 3 data centre in Kinshasa and two further data centres
systems.owner: Government of DR Congo under a USD 150 million deal of October 2025 with United Investment LMT (Mauritius)
systems.tiers: Kinshasa flagship and two others nationwide, to host state data locally; planned

note: A trade-press summary of the 2026-2030 national digital plan: towers, fibre to the 145 territoires, data centres and national e-government platforms. It names no local government office and no plan to connect one; the '1,000 institutions' are not described.
